name: InstallWindmillCLI
description: Installs the Windmill CLI (wmill) from the windmill-cli npm package and puts it on the PATH of the following steps.
helpMarkDown: Runs `npm install windmill-cli` into a private folder under the agent temp directory, then adds its bin folder to PATH. Requires Node.js 20 or later with npm on the agent. See https://www.windmill.dev/docs/advanced/cli/installation
author: Windmill Labs

inputs.name: version
inputs.label: windmill-cli version
inputs.helpMarkDown: npm version or dist-tag of the windmill-cli package, e.g. `latest` or `1.682.0`. Pin a version that matches your Windmill instance.
